body: The same read-only review identified a second concern in seat_clone.rs around 3666-3682. archive_retained_rework_with may accept a private clone based on generated sibling naming/prefix, branch and MERGE_HEAD, without proving it is managed by this main checkout. Before relocation, verify the owning-project identity using the established host/alternates identity seam. Preserve a wrong-main or unverified candidate. Please cover the real private-clone path with one correctly managed positive case and one wrong-main refusal, or explain the trusted existing identity evidence that rules this out. Leave #4388 held.
subject: BUG-2688 private-clone ownership evidence
